faq.q: Does an unknown service-line category confirm a lead pipe?
faq.a: No. Keep unknown recorded as unknown and ask the water provider what evidence is needed to establish the material. Do not convert an incomplete record into either a confirmed lead finding or a non-lead assurance.

faq.q: Is a material inventory the same as a water test?
faq.a: No. A material classification describes service-line information, while a laboratory report concerns a sample and its testing scope. Ask the provider or a qualified professional what the actual records establish.

faq.q: Does every Houston-area address use the City's inventory?
faq.a: Do not assume that. Identify the actual water provider from the property's service information. A utility district, another public system or a private well may require a different records inquiry.

faq.q: Can I request an as-is offer before replacing a line?
faq.a: You can request an evaluation and explain the notice and known condition. A cash proposal does not certify water quality, decide repair responsibility or remove applicable disclosure and closing requirements.
